title: mo flow schema
description: Flow definition — ordered list of steps executed by mo's sequential executor. Consumed by mo (execution engine) and authored by Rey (orchestration package generator) or directly by users.

id.description: Unique step identifier. Used in when refs, node_id, and agents index. Must be lowercase alphanumeric, underscores, hyphens.

role.description: Role name. Resolved via role registry at load time. Unknown roles → fail closed before any LLM call.

task.description: REQUIRED — the concrete task to execute for this step. Blueprint compilation substitutes {task} here; hand-authored flows supply the task directly.

when.description: Optional gate condition. v1 grammar: '<step-id>.status == "success" | "failed"'. References must point to EARLIER steps. No boolean algebra (Tier-2).

context.description: Optional static framing prepended to the task before handing to the role. Maps from blueprint context_spec. When present, the effective prompt is context + newline + task.

tools.description: Optional tool declarations for this step (R-009). Inherited from the blueprint step.
